The area directory identifies accountable bodies separately from operators. Local subcontractor coverage is not a national census.
gaps: Area starts and outcomes are not provider-level performance. Open-to-first-participant dates do not establish full-area capacity.
Procurement-stage entries are not supplier awards. Where the operator is not verified, the commissioner and primary service route remain explicit.
Individual provider grant values, legal dates and service capacity are included only where separately published.
